stem.text: Which statement about the properties of halogens and hydrogen halides is correct?

A.text: A chloride ion is a stronger reducing agent than an iodide ion.

B.text: Chlorine is more volatile than bromine because chlorine has stronger intermolecular forces.

C.text: Hydrogen bromide is more thermally stable than hydrogen iodide because it has a stronger covalent bond.

D.text: Iodine is less reactive than bromine because iodine has weaker covalent bonds.
